title: Count Partitions with Even Sum Difference
summary: Given an integer array of length n, count the partitions at index i (0 <= i < n - 1) where the difference between the sum of the left subarray (indices [0, i]) and the right subarray (indices [i + 1, n - 1]) is even.
statement: Given an integer array of length n, count the partitions at index i (0 <= i < n - 1) where the difference between the sum of the left subarray (indices [0, i]) and the right subarray (indices [i + 1, n - 1]) is even.
constraints: Partition after any index before the last element.
Count partitions where left sum minus right sum is even.
reference_solution:
def count_even_difference_partitions(nums):
    return len(nums)-1 if sum(nums)%2==0 else 0
hints: Then left-right equals 2*left-total, which has the same parity as total.
If total is even, all n-1 partitions qualify; if odd, none do.
This parity identity avoids recomputing every side sum.
editorial: This parity identity avoids recomputing every side sum.

tests.explanation: The total sum is even, so all four possible partitions have even difference.
The total is odd, making every left-right difference odd.
